description_good_justification: README.md opens with what the project is and what it contains.
interact_justification: README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md explain how to get the software, give feedback and contribute.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the process: fork, a pull request against main, the checks that must pass.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the required checks, the test requirement and the style rules.
license_location_justification: LICENSE is at the top level of the repository.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md covers what it is, the architecture and how to run it.
documentation_interface_justification: The README section 'What is in it' maps every module and its role; the modules carry docstrings and docs/ holds the standards and ADRs.
sites_https_justification: GitHub serves the repository, issues and releases over HTTPS; the home page https://pulsai.live redirects to HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, addressable by URL, no proprietary client needed.
maintained_justification: Commits, releases, Dependabot updates and CI run continuously.
repo_interim_justification: The full git history of interim commits and pull requests is public, not only releases.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique git tag (v0.1.0).
release_notes_justification: Hand-written notes summarise the changes and their impact; they are not a git log.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No run-time vulnerability with a CVE was fixed in v0.1.0; the notes say so.
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through GitHub issues; CONTRIBUTING.md says how.
report_responses_justification: No bug report has been received yet, so none is unacknowledged.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request has been received yet, so none is unanswered.
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues are public and searchable.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md describes how to report a vulnerability.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled and SECURITY.md links to it.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received; SECURITY.md commits to an acknowledgement within 72 hours, under the 14-day limit.
build_justification: uv sync and pnpm install rebuild the environment from lockfiles; CI does this on every change.
build_common_tools_justification: uv and pnpm are the common tools of their ecosystems.
build_floss_tools_justification: uv, pnpm, ruff, mypy and vitest are all FLOSS.
test_justification: pytest (backend) and vitest (frontend, including property-based tests); CI runs both on every push and pull request.
test_invocation_justification: uv run pytest, and pnpm --filter web test.
test_most_justification: 83% line coverage on the backend and 85.6% on the frontend.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions CI on every push and pull request.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for new behaviour in the same pull request.
tests_are_added_justification: Pull request 8 added six property-based tests; the database-URL boot guard shipped with tests in backend/tests/test_config.py. SonarQube requires 80% coverage on new code.
tests_documented_added_justification: The test requirement is in CONTRIBUTING.md.
warnings_justification: ruff and mypy --strict (Python) and tsc in strict mode (TypeScript) run in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any finding from those tools.
crypto_published_justification: Only published algorithms: HS256 JWT (PyJWT), Fernet (cryptography), SHA-256.
crypto_keylength_justification: No keys are generated or shipped; the deployer supplies them.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithm (MD5, DES, RC4) is used. SHA-1 appears only as a non-security file-name suffix and cache fingerprint.
crypto_password_storage_justification: This slice stores no user passwords.
crypto_random_justification: No cryptographic keys or nonces are generated here; token ids use uuid4, which is backed by os.urandom.
delivery_mitm_justification: Source and releases are delivered over HTTPS from GitHub.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash or signature is fetched over HTTP; releases carry a signed SLSA provenance file.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No unpatched known vulnerability. The one advisory found (minimatch GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) was fixed the day it appeared; Dependabot alerts are on.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: TruffleHog scans the full history on every push; only the documented local-development database password appears.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-and-quality queries) on every push and pull request, plus ruff and mypy.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security-and-quality queries cover the common vulnerability classes.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request, and weekly.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: No open code alert with a medium or higher security severity. Two high-severity alerts were reviewed and dismissed as false positives with reasons; the two remaining 'high' ones are Scorecard's own score reports.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is in use, so none has reported a vulnerability.
english_justification: Documentation and issue handling are in English.
crypto_call_justification: Uses PyJWT and the cryptography library; no home-made crypto.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No mechanism with known weaknesses (SSLv3, MD5, DES, RC4) is used.
crypto_pfs_justification: No network key-agreement protocol is implemented here; TLS is the platform's.
